harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s reconciliation job with a nonblocking, process-owned flock. Concurrent and interrupted execution, production idempotence, cleanup, and restart persistence all passed. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, SELinux, and SSH remain unchanged and healthy.
actions_performed: Replaced only /srv/legacy2/batch-exclusive-lock/bin/reconcile, preserving ownership, permissions, and SELinux context.
Added automatic kernel-lock release, exit status 75, and a clear message when another invocation owns the job.
Processed production pending.tsv; ledger.tsv now contains B100, B101, and B102 exactly once.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.
Removed rollback/test artifacts and verified no test processes remain.

evidence.summary: Captured platform and protected-data state; reproduced duplicate processing before the repair.

evidence.requirement: Only one invocation processes pending.tsv at a time, with a clear busy result
evidence.summary: Installed nonblocking flock; simultaneous runs produced statuses 0 and 75, the loser emitted the ownership message, and the production busy path made no ledger change.

evidence.requirement: Each batch ID reaches ledger.tsv once while existing entries are preserved
evidence.summary: B100 was preserved; B101 and B102 were added once each; duplicate count is zero and repeated runs leave the checksum unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Interrupted invocation does not permanently block later work
evidence.summary: After SIGTERM, the lock became available and later reconciliation completed successfully.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged; existing util-linux flock was used.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID 2db46909-a020-4fda-b1db-2c3ead04c18a was healthy; reboot was acknowledged; returned boot ID was aaf9f3eb-3e8e-41a8-b900-7bcc1b59f2ba; SSH, system state, lock, script, and data recovered.
Removed rollback/test material and the identified synthetic holder; final verification found no test artifacts or reconciliation processes, SELinux enforcing, SSH listening, and the system running.
